why: Written as a Dispatch (full-moon letter) in Jeannie's voice while belaying Kyle in northern New Mexico; dispatches go to torc.art, but this one was never sent.
Unsent full-moon letter in "we" about both studios, their new archive sites and the Intentionally Confusing project's plans for paid members.

Despite Kyle's byline it is written by Jeannie ("my (Jeannie) grandparents basement") about the walk they made together on the Grand Enchantment Trail in 2010, which first brought them to T or C, so it is a shared expedition.
A shared 2010 thru-hike of the GET through Aravaipa Canyon and the Pinalenos told in Jeannie's first person with captions of both of them; a joint expedition.
A one-photo note about their shared rig "the nook" (334k miles) parked on a bump on the road, so it belongs with the joint travel log.
Kyle's account of a joint climbing day at Cochise ("Jeannie rose to the challenge"), so it is a shared expedition and not his art.
A shared expedition: "we" rigging aerial silks on John Middendorf's bipod 300 ft up a dome at Cochise Stronghold, with Jeannie's first-person movement-installation statement inside.
A short first-person reflection by Kyle written while scrambling to a climbing cliff, part of the same March 2021 joint trip series as the nook and climbing posts.
A numbered dispatch (tag dispatches) in the project "we", announcing their return to the road for art investigations in the wild.
Numbered Dispatch written as "We (Jeannie & Kyle)" launching the Intentionally Confusing project on their 15-year anniversary; dispatches stay whole at torc.art.
A numbered dispatch, which always goes to torc.art; it is written mostly in Jeannie's first person about Turtleback Mountain, fossils and T or C.
A numbered Dispatch, written as "we" about the Gila and the Grand Enchantment Trail.
Numbered Dispatch: a YouTube video with a three-line poem; Dispatches stay whole on torc.art.
A numbered Dispatch: "we" depart on the road, ten years after the teardrop trailer.
A numbered Dispatch in "we" voice about summer on the prairie edge; the Dispatch run stays whole on torc.art.
A joint film credited "by Jeannie Ortiz and Kyle Parker Cunningham" with a haiku, tagged film/wyoming.
A numbered Dispatch written as "we" about the Wyoming prairie and Montana fires.
A numbered Dispatch from Jeannie and Kyle in Montana, captioned photo essay.
A joint foraging film written as "we" ("dye yarn for our weaving art"), from their shared summer travels.
Numbered Dispatch of their shared Montana trip (bears at Cowen, climbing the Beehive), closing with the project's raven logo note.
The post is only a YouTube link with a thumbnail and no text; it belongs to the film experiments they describe elsewhere as joint ("we have been experimenting with film").

A third-person Desert Archaic exhibition record of Kyle's October 2021 show, quoting his statement; it is part of the gallery's exhibitions series (tag "Desert Archaic", exhibitions), backfilled in Dec 2022.
A numbered dispatch in the joint "we" introducing their mushroom foraging film.
A numbered Dispatch, so it stays in the run, though it is entirely Jeannie's dye project; much of its text is already on her site as Trajectory of Color.
A gallery-voice record of Jeannie exhibiting her Perception cloak and Leaf Cape at Desert Archaic in Dec 2021, quoting her; it belongs to the gallery exhibitions series.
A gallery-voice record of Jeannie installing two handwoven art yardages for the Dec 2021 Art Hop at Desert Archaic; it belongs to the exhibitions series.
The gallery thanks visitors to the last Art Hop of 2021 at Desert Archaic, with photos of the gallery that night.
The 'we' statement of purpose for the intentionally confusing project, which is the joint project that torc.art now carries.
A numbered Dispatch signed Jeannie & Kyle, showing her Blues and his Paper Neck Giraffes and a joint film.
A stop-motion film by both: "Jeannie Ortiz performs on the Lyra. Kyle Parker Cunningham films, edits and created the sounds."
Jeannie's first-person account of the shared 2010 GET hike that first brought them both to Truth or Consequences.
A numbered Dispatch: the joint plans for 2022 (websites, a book, films, the members sketchbook, the random draw).
The index page for their shared 2010 walk of the GET that brought them to Truth or Consequences ("our journey", "we started walking").
A gallery-voice record of Jeannie's 24-hour warp installation at Desert Archaic for the Feb 2022 Art Hop, quoting her; it belongs to the exhibitions series.
Numbered Dispatch; Jeannie's essay on finding weaving in India in 2008–2010, kept with the Dispatch run.
A joint installation of works on paper by Jeannie and Kyle at Desert Archaic in spring 2022, with a timelapse "by the good folks at Intentionally Confusing".
A two-line Desert Archaic exhibitions entry for Kyle's March 2022 installation, part of the gallery's exhibition series.
A numbered dispatch signed Jeannie & Kyle about the Italy trip and drawing two custom spots.
A numbered Dispatch in three parts: Jeannie on movement, the garden, and Kyle's essay on the Rondanini Pietà and his new painting.
Paid-supporter letter signed "Jeannie & Kyle" about the project, Jeannie's custom slots for patrons, Desert Archaic and their joint show Mycelium Mysterium; joint, not Jeannie's alone.
A sustaining-member note signed "Jeannie & Kyle": a lunar-eclipse camping trip, the van that would not start, and the launch of their joint art-clothing store with both artists' work.
Numbered Dispatch: the lunar eclipse and Black Fire, Kyle's Meown Juniper painting, Jeannie's Night and Leylines sales, and the new shop.
A numbered dispatch signed Jeannie and Kyle presenting two joint short films.
An unpublished draft whose slug is dispatch-20; it is a "we" essay on their joint film practice and the arc of time, so it goes with the Dispatches.
A numbered Dispatch: Kyle at MARBLE/marble, Jeannie's bee video, and her mushroom guide recommendations.
Numbered Dispatch about the six-year rebuild of their cabin west of Taos, written as "we"; dispatches stay whole at torc.art.
A short unfinished "we" essay about the two of them choosing T or C in 2011 to make art full time, and thanking their supporters.
A numbered Dispatch (kept with the run), a short note from Jeannie with a palimpsest image made for her sister.
Numbered Dispatch signed Jeannie & Kyle: autumn studio news, Jeannie's two woolen blankets for sale, and Kyle's 'So I Now Must Learn to Act' AI short-film section.
The gallery's own page, with a prose poem on T or C and the Caballo Mountains, a Friends list and the 324 Broadway address and map.
Numbered Dispatch on their 12th year in Truth or Consequences, Jeannie's Movement of Stone installed at Desert Archaic, and Kyle's paintings for sale.
Numbered Dispatch signed Jeannie & Kyle about the future of their gallery Desert Archaic, an unnamed weaving on the loom, and a whiteout ski day.
Numbered Dispatch announcing the purchase of the 312 Main Street building, the future gallery; dispatches stay whole at torc.art.
A numbered Dispatch: the last Art Hop at 324 Broadway, the renovation of the new building, and Kyle at Revel in Art.
A numbered Dispatch: Kyle's grandfather's Dust Bowl story, the stucco summer on the new building, and Jeannie on shawls.
Numbered Dispatch with Kyle's equinox note, Jeannie's "A Small Flock" (three weavings by draw, auction and patrons-only) and Kyle's lightning-strike story.
A numbered Dispatch on finishing the new gallery space, the December 7 opening, and Jeannie's new sculptural weavings; the run stays whole.
A numbered Dispatch about autumn, the gallery's 12th anniversary sale and Kyle's new paintings.
A numbered Dispatch: Jeannie's yardage-woven statistics for 2015–2023 and Kyle's roadside-art gift story.
Jeannie's letter pairs her Nephos draw with Kyle's new gold-leaf intaglio prints and his Art Hop sale at T or C Contemporary.

Jeannie opens a custom-spot draw in her first person, then the post presents Kyle's gold-leaf drypoint prints and their joint March show at Truth or Consequences Contemporary, signed Jeannie and Kyle.
